name: Sahel insurgency
summary: Gunmen kill 38 villagers near Téra in western Niger on 12 Nov; insurgency sustained across the Sahel
state: Armed men ambushed villagers travelling to market near Téra in western Niger on 12 Nov, killing 38 including 11 members of a local self-defence group, a former local official told AFP (DH/Belga, 13 Nov). Human Rights Watch reported on 4 Nov that an Islamist armed group in Burkina Faso is targeting civilians. JNIM and Islamic State Sahel Province keep fighting state forces, but no fall or blockade of a capital or mass-casualty attack in a coastal state was found as of 26 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: For travel, follow FCDO advice against all travel to most of Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger.
rubric_hit: Sustained insurgency at current levels = Watch; no capital blockade or coastal-state mass-casualty attack

sources.title: DH/Belga — Niger: au moins 37 civils tués par des hommes armés dans l'ouest

why: Jihadist groups control growing territory across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, driving displacement and coastal-state spillover.
drivers: JNIM/IS-Sahel offensives, juntas, Russian forces, blockades, coastal-state attacks.

rubric.alert: Blockade or fall of a capital or major city, or mass-casualty attacks spreading to coastal states.
